pages.title: Hyperframe Casing
pages.text: A casing laced with topological insulator and superposition crystal, so that its interior exists in several overlapping configurations at once. It looks solid but sounds slightly hollow, as though echoing in a direction I cannot see.

$(thing)Notebook$()$(br)Hyperdimensional machines needed a frame that could be in more than one shape. Topological insulators conduct only on the surface and superposition crystals hold several states, and together over spacetime casing they gave the frame its depth.

Made in a crafting grid.$(br2)$(thing)Unlocked by$(): Horizon Simulation.$(br2)$(thing)Used in$(): Chronoplastic Casing, Compactification Lathe, Containment Cache, Dimensional Stabiliser, Graviton Condenser, Graviton Lens Array, Higgs Field Modulator, Hyperlattice Frame and more.
